summary: Full-stack testing of Dental Opportunity Hub. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me), opportunities (list, filters mode/city/verified/q, create pending, get, my), applications (apply, duplicate 400, my), directory (dentists/clinics/user, phone hidden, no password_hash leak), admin (stats, moderation status change, feature, verify user levels, users/apps listing, RBAC 403 for non-admin). Frontend UI: home hero toggle + search + quick chips, Find Opportunities list/filters/detail, seeker & giver multi-step registration, login (correct & wrong password does not crash), apply flow (button becomes 'Applied' & disabled), dentist + clinic directory + public profiles, unauthenticated redirects for /post /dashboard /admin -> /login, admin login redirect to /admin, admin stats visible, admin moderation approve pending opportunity, admin verify user badge toggle, post opportunity multi-step create -> detail page with 'Opportunity submitted for review' toast.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the Apply dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.

(Optional) Email validation via pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test / .example. Consider showing a friendlier message from 422 validation errors on the Register submit; today it goes into formatApiError but a raw list body may show unclearly.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_data.py: DEMO_DENTISTS listed as seekers looking for 'MDS Admission', but the LOOKING_QUICK/OFFERING sets on Home don't fully mirror categories in seeded opportunities — cosmetic only.
Backend admin stats endpoint counts seekers as 'dentists' and givers as 'clinics'; acceptable for demo but may inflate 'clinics' with labs.
server.py `require_admin` correctly returns 403 for non-admins; verified in tests.
Register EmailStr validation returns Pydantic 422 with an array `detail`. `formatApiError` should be robust to list-of-errors (already displayed a toast in wrong-password test).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 13 UI flows tested passed after correcting invalid .test-TLD email in the test script)

test_credentials: Admin vsv.visakhapatnam@gmail.com / DentalHub@2026 works. Test users created dynamically via UI+API with @example.com emails (email-validator rejects reserved TLDs .test/.example* — use real-looking domains).

Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. When registering test users through pydantic EmailStr, avoid TLDs .test/.example/.invalid/.localhost (email-validator rejects them). Test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs pytest with JUnit XML in /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
